LevelPage.tipsTitle: How to keep a high level

tips.title: Book early
tips.text: Booking more than 14 days ahead adds 50% to productivity points: 100 points become 150.

tips.title: Cancel as early as possible
tips.text: Cancelling 48–72 hours before the start costs 20 points, less than an hour before — 150, after the booking starts — 175.

tips.title: Better to cancel than not show up
tips.text: A no-show costs 200 points and a banana. Even a late cancellation is cheaper and has no banana.

tips.title: Make your first scan right away
tips.text: Lateness counts until the first scan, leaving early — after the last one. Start scanning immediately and work until the booking ends.

tips.title: Keep the pace
tips.text: 100% productivity gives 100 points, 150% — 200. Below 20% is already a deduction.

tips.title: A bad day will be forgotten
tips.text: Points and deductions older than 30 days don't count in the rating — you can recover a dropped level within a month.

faq.title: What are bananas in Ozon Job?
faq.text: That's what the app calls critical violations: not showing up for a slot, productivity below 20% of the process average and being late to an Ozon fresh mini-warehouse. Each violation earns one banana.

faq.title: How many bananas until a ban?
faq.text: 1–3 bananas — a warning, 4 — all bookings are cancelled, 5 — a 2-day ban, 6 — 7 days, 7 or more — 30 days. Bananas are not reset after a ban.

faq.title: How do I remove a banana?
faq.text: Work slots without violations: every 3 bookings in a row without violations remove one banana.

faq.title: How do I raise my level in Ozon Job?
faq.text: Earn points: productivity (up to 200 points per slot), early booking (up to +50% on top), no no-shows or late cancellations. Only the last 30 days count, and the level updates within an hour after a shift.

faq.title: How many points are deducted for cancelling a booking?
faq.text: From 20 points when cancelling less than 72 hours ahead to 150 — less than an hour ahead; after the booking starts — 175. A no-show costs 200 points and a banana, so if you can't make it, it's better to cancel.

faq.title: When does a newcomer get a level?
faq.text: At first the level is “Newcomer”: the rating is forming, banana restrictions don't apply and payouts arrive after 3 hours. The level appears after 55 hours on site — or earlier if results are very good or very poor.

faq.title: What does the “Diamond” level give?
faq.text: Booking slots a year ahead, payouts to an Ozon Bank card after 3 hours and manual withdrawals once an hour. According to the scale in the app, it requires more than 599 points over 30 days.

how.title: Choose an offer
how.text: Click “Apply” in the card — the Ozon Bank invitation page with your conditions will open.

how.title: Apply in time
how.text: You usually have 72 hours or 10 days to apply — the deadline is in the card under “What you need to do”.

how.title: Meet the conditions
how.text: For example, make purchases with the card outside Ozon. Perks and bonuses are credited by the bank — under its own rules and timelines.

faq.title: What is an invitation and why follow the link?
faq.text: It's a link from Ozon Bank's “Bring a friend” programme. With it, you get a product on the terms for invited customers — the bank shows them on the invitation page.

faq.title: How much time do I have after following the link?
faq.text: It depends on the product: order a debit card within 72 hours, apply for a credit card or business account within 72 hours, submit a business registration request within 10 days. Missed the debit card deadline? Open the link again and the countdown restarts.

faq.title: Which purchases count?
faq.text: Purchases with an Ozon Bank card outside Ozon. QR code and SBP payments don't count. A purchase counts after 3–5 days, once the bank processes the transaction.

faq.title: Does the invitation work if I'm already an Ozon Bank customer?
faq.text: It depends on the product. For example, the salary card invitation won't count if your salary already goes to Ozon Bank, and the business account one — if you already have an account or applied within the last 14 days. Exact conditions are on the invitation page.

faq.title: Do I need to be self-employed?
faq.text: Not for Ozon Bank products. For Ozon Blogger — yes: rewards are paid only to self-employed Russian citizens via Ozon Profit, twice a month. You can work part-time via Ozon Job under a civil-law contract, as self-employed or as a sole proprietor.

faq.title: Is it paid?
faq.text: No. Following the link is free, and you pay nothing to the site. Product rates and conditions are set by Ozon and Ozon Bank.

faq.title: Are you Ozon or Ozon Bank?
faq.text: No. This is an independent information site: we've gathered invitations and summarised the conditions from Ozon and Ozon Bank help pages. Only they decide on issuing a card, opening an account or joining a programme.

SupportPage.title: Ozon Job: questions on shifts, payouts, rating
SupportPage.description: Answers to frequent questions about part-time work via Ozon Job: registration, booking and cancelling shifts, payouts and taxes, rating, invitation code bonus.
SupportPage.heading: Questions and answers about part-time work via Ozon Job
SupportPage.lead: We've gathered answers to frequent questions — from registration to payouts, rating and bonuses. Facts come from the Ozon Job help centre for contractors. Didn't find an answer? We'll tell you where to write.

account.title: Registration and documents
account.lead: Who can work, what you need to register and how to manage your account.

items.title: How do I register in Ozon Job?
items.text: Download the app, tap “Join” and sign in with your phone number. Choose a warehouse and citizenship, confirm your details via Gosuslugi or Ozon Bank, enter your INN and SNILS, choose a cooperation type and fill in your bank details. Once your profile is checked, you can book your first slot.

items.title: Can foreign citizens work?
items.text: You can register, including with a patent: you'll need a document confirming your grounds for staying in Russia and an account in your own name. But according to the Ozon Job help centre, foreign citizens can currently book only bicycle delivery, not warehouse slots. The patent must be renewed and paid on time — otherwise the contract is terminated.

items.title: Do I need a medical record book?
items.text: No, Ozon warehouses don't require one. If you already have one, bring it to your first shift.

items.title: How do I change my personal details or phone number?
items.text: Your details come from Gosuslugi or Ozon Bank at registration — correct them there, then write to Ozon Job support. After registration you can't change your phone number: you can terminate the contract and register again with a new number.

items.title: Can I change my cooperation type?
items.text: Yes, Russian citizens can do this up to 10 times in total: Profile → “About me” → “Cooperation type”. First wait for payouts for completed slots: after changing the type you won't be able to receive them.

items.title: How do I terminate the contract?
items.text: In your profile: “About me” → “Terminate contract”. You can do this if you have no outstanding penalties, all slots are completed and payouts have arrived. Payout history and documents stay in the app, and you can resume cooperation no more than 5 times.

shifts.title: Shifts and the first day
shifts.lead: How to book, cancel a booking and what to expect at the warehouse.
shifts.more: First steps: from registration to your shift

items.title: What shifts are there?
items.text: Day and night slots of 4, 6, 8 or 12 hours. Availability depends on the warehouse: some have only 12-hour slots. If the warehouse you want isn't listed, all its slots are taken or your profile has a different region.

items.title: Can I reschedule or cancel a booking?
items.text: You can't change a booking — only cancel it (“Bookings” → booking → “Cancel”) and book a new slot. Cancel 48 hours ahead or earlier: late cancellation lowers your rating, and according to the help centre, cancelling less than an hour before the start or not showing up leads to a 2-day block. A slot that has started can't be cancelled.

items.title: Why was my booking cancelled?
items.text: Ozon may cancel a booking itself: if you booked training right after registering and your profile hasn't been checked yet — 4 hours before the start; if a newcomer (under 55 hours on site) booked more than 7 days ahead; if a mandatory online course with a deadline isn't completed 3 hours before the slot. Check the app before leaving home.

items.title: What should I bring and wear?
items.text: A passport, INN and SNILS — you can show them electronically. At a regular warehouse you get a protective kit: its cost is withheld from payouts, and 1,500 ₽ is returned after a certain number of operations under the offer. Ozon fresh mini-warehouses don't provide a kit — you need flat closed-toe shoes with a firm heel, trousers and a T-shirt. Phones, food and personal belongings are not allowed in the goods storage area.

items.title: What happens if I'm late?
items.text: The warehouse may not let you start the slot that day, and lateness lowers your rating. If the bus to the warehouse is late, dispatchers usually warn the warehouse — you'll be let in. Arrive 30 minutes before the start: you need to pass the checkpoint and change.

items.title: What are trips?
items.text: Booking slots in another city with a hostel stay — for Russian citizens over 18 with a suitable rating level. Accommodation isn't free: its cost is withheld from payouts per day, plus 6 ₽ for the booking; you pay for travel yourself. You can cancel a trip no later than 24 hours ahead.

items.title: Can I combine it with a main job or move to staff?
items.text: You can combine them: slots under a civil-law contract don't interfere with your main job. Ozon offers experienced contractors who are Russian citizens a move to staff with a fixed schedule at one warehouse: apply in the app (Profile → “About me” → “Cooperation type” → “Staff employee”).

money.title: Payouts and taxes
money.lead: When and how much you're paid, where the money goes and who pays the tax.
money.more: How the payout is calculated and when the money arrives

items.title: Why is the payout lower than expected?
items.text: The expected payout is a guide based on average productivity, not a guarantee. The result depends on the number of operations and the rate; tax, penalties and deductions — for example, for the protective kit — are subtracted. A detailed breakdown appears in the app the day after the slot.

items.title: The payout didn't arrive — what should I do?
items.text: Open “Payouts” → “Account history”: the app shows the reason for a failed transaction. Common ones are a wrong BIC or account number, different details at the bank and in Ozon Job, a closed or frozen account, or penalties exceeding earnings. If the payout is under additional review, it will arrive within 14 days.

items.title: Can I receive money on another bank's card?
items.text: Yes: “Payouts” → “Bank details” → “Change bank details”. The account number must start with 40817 or 40914; money arrives once a week, on Tuesdays. After changing details, payouts are paused for 3 hours for verification. Self-employed people, sole proprietors and foreign citizens can only specify their own account.

items.title: Who pays the tax if I'm self-employed?
items.text: From 1 October 2026, Ozon Job withholds and pays the tax for all self-employed contractors (for new ones — from 26 August 2026). If you paid yourself via “My Tax” or an automatic bank payment, turn it off so the tax isn't charged twice. The amount is shown in “Payouts” → “Automatic tax payment”.

items.title: How do I get a 2-NDFL certificate?
items.text: If you work under a civil-law contract: “Payouts” → “2-NDFL certificates” → “Generate certificate”, choose the year. It takes 3 working days; for the current year it includes only full past months. Ozon Job doesn't issue other certificates.

items.title: Is sick leave paid?
items.text: Under a civil-law contract — yes, if last year's contributions are at least the cost of an insurance year (minimum wage × regional coefficient × 2.9% × 12). Ozon Job pays the first 3 days, the Social Fund pays the rest. Write to the support chat and attach the sick note, a Social Fund statement and an application.

rating.title: Rating, penalties and blocks
rating.lead: What affects your level, what money is withheld for and what gets you blocked.
rating.more: Levels, points and the rating calculator

items.title: How does the rating work?
items.text: Your level depends on points over the last 30 days. Points are awarded for productivity and early booking and deducted for low productivity, lateness, late cancellations and no-shows. The higher the level, the earlier booking opens and the faster payouts arrive.

items.title: What gets you blocked?
items.text: The main reason is “bananas” for no-shows and violations: at the 4th banana all bookings are cancelled, at the 5th — a 2-day ban, the 6th — 7 days, from the 7th — 30 days. One banana is removed for 3 slots in a row without violations. Self-employed contractors who cancel receipts lose access for a year.

items.title: What penalties and deductions are there?
items.text: The cost of trip accommodation and the protective kit is withheld, as well as penalties and claims — for breaking rules and safety requirements, losing or damaging goods. For first violations of some rules you get a warning first. For self-employed people and sole proprietors, debt is withheld in parts — no more than 50% of the payout per slot. Everything is shown in “Payouts” → “Deductions and errors”.

items.title: How do I appeal a penalty?
items.text: Within 3 days of the debt appearing, write a free-form objection to support explaining why you disagree. If the penalty is cancelled, it will appear in “Payouts” → “Deductions and errors” → “Archive” with the status “Cancelled”.

bonus.title: Bonuses and promotions
bonus.lead: The invitation code, “Starter support” and other payouts.
bonus.more: The invitation code and how to enter it

items.title: How do I get the invitation code bonus?
items.text: Enter the code in the app — on the home screen, on the promotion page or in Profile → “Bring a friend” — and meet the conditions. Operations count at the warehouse you chose for your first booking. The amount depends on the warehouse: per Ozon Job lists for September 2026 — 1,000 to 5,000 ₽; the condition is, for example, earning 30,000 ₽ within 30 days of the first shift.

items.title: Who can take part in “Bring a friend”?
items.text: The invited person must not have worked at Ozon before. The inviter must have completed tasks on at least one slot — they'll find their code in Profile → “Bring a friend”. The code changes when the contract is re-signed.

items.title: What is “Starter support”?
items.text: A promotion for newcomers: the first, training day is paid under it rather than as a regular slot — up to 6,500 ₽ according to job.ozon.ru. Complete the online courses before your shift: at the warehouse you'll manage more operations and earn more.

items.title: Are there other bonuses?
items.text: Yes: warehouse promotions in the app, points at Ozon fresh mini-warehouses — up to 150 per slot (1 point = 1 ₽ for goods from the fresh showcase, valid for a month), partner discounts and contests. The conditions of each promotion are in the app.

items.text: No: we have no access to Ozon accounts or data. For any account questions, write to the support chat in the Ozon Job app. If someone in chats or social networks asks for an SMS code or card details “for a payout”, they are scammers.

items.text: Write to us by email or Telegram — contacts are on this page. Check dates are shown in every section of the site, and Ozon's conditions change: we try to update the data in time.

tips.title: When does the money for a shift arrive?
tips.text: To an Ozon Bank card — 3 hours after the slot at the “Newcomer” and “Diamond” levels, or 12 hours at other levels; “Diamond” can withdraw money manually once an hour. To other banks' cards — once a week, on Tuesdays.

tips.title: How much can I earn per shift?
tips.text: The payout is the number of operations (scans) × a rate that depends on the warehouse and the item's dimensions. The expected amount per hour and per 12-hour slot is shown on the warehouse card in the app, and a detailed breakdown appears the day after the slot.

tips.title: What documents do I need?
tips.text: To register — a passport, INN and SNILS: the data is pulled in via Gosuslugi or Ozon Bank. Bring your passport to the first shift; INN and SNILS can be shown electronically.

tips.title: From what age can I work a shift?
tips.text: Russian citizens — from 16. If you're under 18, for the first shift you'll need a 086/u medical certificate and parental consent using the template from the offer, and night slots won't be available.

tips.title: How do I sign up: civil-law contract, self-employment or sole proprietorship?
tips.text: Under a civil-law contract Ozon pays the taxes for you. For self-employed people Ozon Job also withholds the tax — automatic payment is mandatory for everyone from 1 October 2026; sole proprietors pay tax themselves. Self-employed contractors can take no more than 8 warehouse slots a month, and self-employment isn't available if you've worked in the Ozon group of companies in the last 2 years.

tips.title: Do I need experience, and is the first day paid?
tips.text: No experience needed: the first slot is a training one — you'll be shown the warehouse rules and given a data collection terminal (handheld scanner). The first day is paid under the “Starter support” promotion rather than as a regular slot; online courses before your shift will help you earn more.

tips.title: How do I book a shift?
tips.text: In the “Warehouses” section choose a warehouse, process, date and slot length — 4, 6, 8 or 12 hours. For the next 3 days the booking is confirmed immediately; for later dates — via a queue: the higher your rating, the better your chance. Cancel in advance: the closer to the start, the more rating points are deducted, and a no-show costs 200 points and a “banana”.
